facts.name: card_inner_labels
facts.note: number of inner labels = admissible data codes (4 link bits + 4 corner bits)

facts.name: card_bright_labels
facts.note: inner labels with no corner bit set (the codes K acts on)

facts.name: card_dark_labels
facts.note: inner labels with a corner bit set (K = 0 on them)

facts.name: card_bright_pairs
facts.note: bright codes come in pairs y <-> y xor 0b1111 (K couples only the two members)

facts.name: card_states_spinnet
facts.note: physical states = distinct computational-basis codes y + 256 o

facts.name: mult_two
facts.note: states of the vacuum pair 0000 <-> 1111, |K| = 2 (multiplicity of the eigenvalues -2 and +2)

facts.name: mult_one
facts.note: states of the six pairs with |K| = 1 (multiplicity of the eigenvalues -1 and +1)

facts.name: mult_half
facts.note: states of the alternating pair 0101 <-> 1010, |K| = 1/2 (multiplicity of -1/2 and +1/2)

facts.name: spectrum_multiplicities
facts.note: multiplicity of each eigenvalue of H_B (= the spectrum of K block by block) on the 433 states, as [eigenvalue, multiplicity]

facts.name: couplings_2k
facts.note: 2K from the Racah 6j symbols on all 47 inner codes; the map is 2K -> number of bright pairs with that coupling ('0': number of dark codes, K = 0). K = -2 (0000<->1111), -1/2 (0101<->1010), +1 (six pairs)

facts.name: ub_exact_semantics
facts.note: the exact semantics of the reference U_B circuit equals exp(-i beta K) of every valid inner code, for all beta

provenance.values_from: Lean theorem statements, cross-checked against the Python encoding
